title: Flux 3 Action SO-101
description: FLUX 3 Action turns what the robot sees into what it does next. Give it the scene camera image, the wrist camera image, the current SO-101 joint state (shoulder pan, shoulder lift, elbow flex, wrist flex, wrist roll, gripper) and a plain-language instruction such as "Pick up the yellow cube and place it inside the black rectangle". It returns a chunk of 42 target joint positions at 30 Hz, that is 1.4 s of motion. In a control loop, execute the first 32 steps (about 1 s), then call again with fresh images and joint state.

pricing.text: Pricing can change for this endpoint. Your request will cost $0.003 per compute second. A typical call (one 42-step action chunk) is billed about 0.5 to 2 s of compute, so roughly $0.0015 to $0.006 per call, or about 1 s of robot motion.

estimate.note: billed by compute time - no per-run figure

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Natural-language task instruction for the robot.

inputs.name: scene_image
inputs.tooltip: Current frame from the fixed scene camera (tiled left). Resized to 256x256.

inputs.name: wrist_image
inputs.tooltip: Current frame from the wrist camera (tiled right). Resized to 256x256.

inputs.name: state
inputs.tooltip: Measured state: shoulder pan, shoulder lift, elbow flex, wrist flex, wrist roll (degrees), gripper (percent). JSON. Required.

inputs.name: state_history
inputs.tooltip: Measured states at the 7 control ticks (30 Hz) before `state`, oldest first. Requires `command_history`. Omit for a fresh episode. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: command_history
inputs.tooltip: Absolute commands in effect at each of the 8 observation ticks, oldest first; the last row is the most recent command sent. Requires `state_history`. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: history_scene_image
inputs.tooltip: Scene frame from the oldest history tick (7 ticks before now). Requires `state_history`. Defaults to the current frame.

inputs.name: history_wrist_image
inputs.tooltip: Wrist frame from the oldest history tick. Requires `state_history`.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: Euler denoising steps. The checkpoint was validated at 4.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance on video and action; 1.0 disables CFG.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Sampling seed. Omit for a random seed; the reference evaluation seed is 0 for DROID and 42 for SO-101. -1 leaves it to the model.
